title: boxes on a segment's canvas to points on its surface (the registry's canvas-to-volume converter)
notes: A convert step, never a menu entry or a stage: an output of kind points in the canvas-boxes/1 format names it, and VC3D loads the point collection it writes. Each box's center is looked up on the active segment's tifxyz grid (x, y, z in level-0 voxels). The points mark places on the surface; they are not results.

boxes.label: a canvas-boxes/1 document: boxes on the segment's render canvas (frame canvas) or its tifxyz grid (frame grid)

surface.label: the segment the boxes are on (the run's active segment)

points.label: one point per box that lands on a valid vertex, in box order

report.label: where each box landed (bilinear or nearest vertex) and the boxes skipped

compute.scales_with: the segment's grid vertices (three TIFFs read once)

facts.title: toolreg
facts.tagline: one registry of tools for the command line, VC3D and AutoPipeline
facts.network: None. A tool it runs uses the network only as its own page and its manifest's `safety.network` say; reading a running VC3D uses its local socket
facts.success: exit 0, `status` `ok`, `controls.verdict` `present` or `not applicable`, and no `format_gate` row with verdict `fail`.
facts.not_a_pass: `controls.verdict` `no control: not a pass`; exit 4 (planned, nothing ran); a `target` gate of `warn` read as a check that the scroll is not eligible; a tool's own report that its page's Not a pass rule names.
facts.never: pass `--allow-outside` or `--yes-download` without reading what the manifest says it writes or fetches; edit a manifest's facts block by hand; open a result whose status is not ok; call an ink map a reading.
